prompt:
Create a high-fidelity OmniGear 'Geral' settings UI design comparison. Use supplied approved screen as VISUAL IDENTITY reference only: exact header, sidebar, typography, neutral black/white palette, thin dividers, realistic matte black mouse. REPLACE performance controls and metrics with device information and profile reset. Output a SQUARE comparison board of TWO complete equal desktop landscape app viewports stacked vertically: dark top, light bottom, matching content and structure. Readable Brazilian Portuguese; no browser frames or exterior titles.
Header 'OmniGear' and small 'Demonstração' badge. ONE moon outline icon top-right on dark and ONE sun outline icon on light, no switch or simultaneous pair. Sidebar20%: '← Dispositivos', 'Mouse de demonstração', 'Perfil 1' dropdown, menu 'Botões','DPI','Desempenho','Parâmetros','Perfis','Geral' SELECTED.
Main heading 'Geral', subtitle 'Informações do dispositivo e ajustes gerais.'
Device info exact content: 'Modelo' / 'Mouse de demonstração'; 'Conexão' / 'USB (simulada)'; 'Firmware' / 'Não informado'; 'Perfil em uso' / 'Perfil 1'. Small status text 'Modo demonstração'. Do not invent real model brand, battery telemetry, firmware versions or update availability.
One clearly separated maintenance section headed 'Restaurar ajustes', helper 'Redefine os ajustes do perfil atual. Os demais perfis são mantidos.' Button 'Restaurar padrões' with neutral outlined style, small reset-arrow icon, placed below or to right of explanation. Extra concise note 'Você poderá revisar antes de salvar.' This operation restores draft and requires confirmation, not immediate full factory erase. Do not draw confirmation overlay yet. No firmware update, pairing, cloud, account, delete device or extra features.
This screen is CLEAN saved state, so no dirty bar and no Save/Discard buttons. At the main bottom optional understated check 'Nenhuma alteração pendente'. Do not show any latency, DPI, frequency or battery values from reference. Pure neutral palette. Good contrast and breathing room, information clear and reset action appropriately separated.
OPTION2: Below heading a full-width horizontal device identity band: medium-small realistic matte mouse top view rotated horizontally on LEFT, next to 'Mouse de demonstração' and 'Modo demonstração' text. No framed card. Beneath this band, one horizontal rule, three evenly spaced information columns 'Conexão'USB(simulada), 'Firmware'Não informado, 'Perfil em uso'Perfil1; model already shown in device band so do not duplicate Modelo row. Beneath another thin rule, full-width restoration row with 'Restaurar ajustes', helper and note on LEFT, outlined 'Restaurar padrões' button on RIGHT. The identity band is compact about130px per desktop viewport. Structure horizontal tiers, not split tall columns. Bottom quiet clean-status line.
title: Resumo no topo
description: Identificação horizontal, seguida de informações e manutenção.
notes: Device information is explicitly demo/unknown. Restore defaults is a proposed current-profile draft reset, requiring confirmation and subsequent explicit save; not hardware factory reset. Firmware updates and pairing remain outside confirmed scope. Clean state shown; dirty state uses shared draft bar.
